# Zhang-Suen thinning

def thin(mask):
 a=np.pad(mask.astype(np.uint8),1)
 for step in range(2000):
  changed=False
  for phase in (0,1):
   p=[a[:-2,1:-1],a[:-2,2:],a[1:-1,2:],a[2:,2:],a[2:,1:-1],a[2:,:-2],a[1:-1,:-2],a[:-2,:-2]]
   N=sum(p);S=sum((p[i]==0)&(p[(i+1)%8]==1) for i in range(8))
   if phase==0: test=(p[0]*p[2]*p[4]==0)&(p[2]*p[4]*p[6]==0)
   else:test=(p[0]*p[2]*p[6]==0)&(p[0]*p[4]*p[6]==0)
   rm=(a[1:-1,1:-1]>0)&(N>=2)&(N<=6)&(S==1)&test
   if rm.any():a[1:-1,1:-1][rm]=0;changed=True
  if not changed:break

def disk(canvas,y,x,r,val=1):
 r=max(.1,r);ya=max(0,int(y-r-1));yb=min(canvas.shape[0],int(y+r+2));xa=max(0,int(x-r-1));xb=min(canvas.shape[1],int(x+r+2))
 yy,xx=np.ogrid[ya:yb,xa:xb]; patch=canvas[ya:yb,xa:xb];patch[(yy-y)**2+(xx-x)**2<=r*r]=val

def make_component(mask):
 import heapq
 dist=nd.distance_transform_edt(mask)
 # Boundary noise is smoothed for the path centreline.
 smooth=nd.gaussian_filter(mask.astype(float),1)>0.45
 sk=thin(smooth)&mask
 if not sk.any():sk[np.unravel_index(np.argmax(dist),dist.shape)]=1
 # Remove leaf twigs within the same broad footprint later through coverage.
 yy,xx=np.where(sk)
 cover=np.zeros(mask.shape,bool)
 rad=np.minimum(np.maximum(dist-.3,0),28.)
 for y,x in zip(yy,xx):disk(cover,y,x,rad[y,x])
 # Greedy extra centres for areas wider than a single brush pass and off-centre skeleton.
 extra=[]
 for k in range(1000):
  deficit=mask&~cover
  if not deficit.any():break
  interior=nd.distance_transform_edt(deficit)
  if interior.max()<1.8:break
  # Find an inscribed disk near the largest uncovered island.
  y,x=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(interior),interior.shape)
  rr=rad[y,x]
  if rr<2:cover[y,x]=True;continue
  extra.append((y,x));disk(cover,y,x,rr)
 # connect extra centres to the network through the component
 for y,x in extra:
  _,idx=nd.distance_transform_edt(~sk,return_indices=True)
  ey,ex=idx[:,y,x];n=int(np.hypot(ey-y,ex-x)*2)+1
  ys=np.rint(np.linspace(y,ey,n)).astype(int);xs=np.rint(np.linspace(x,ex,n)).astype(int)
  if mask[ys,xs].all():sk[ys,xs]=True
  else:
   pq=[(0,y,x)];prev={(y,x):None};cost={(y,x):0};end=None
   while pq:
    v,a,b=heapq.heappop(pq)
    if v>cost[a,b]:continue
    if sk[a,b]:end=(a,b);break
    for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
     c,d=a+dy,b+dx
     if c<0 or d<0 or c>=mask.shape[0] or d>=mask.shape[1] or not mask[c,d]:continue
     vv=v+1+2/(dist[c,d]+1)
     if vv<cost.get((c,d),1e10):cost[c,d]=vv;prev[c,d]=(a,b);heapq.heappush(pq,(vv,c,d))
   while end is not None:sk[end]=True;end=prev[end]
 # Pixel graph MST and open tree traversal, retaining physical brush width.
 yy,xx=np.where(sk);ids=np.full(sk.shape,-1,int);ids[yy,xx]=np.arange(len(yy)); rows=[];cols=[];weights=[]
 for dy,dx in [(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0),(1,1)]:
  cy=yy+dy;cx=xx+dx;valid=(cy>=0)&(cx>=0)&(cy<sk.shape[0])&(cx<sk.shape[1]);ii=np.where(valid)[0]; jj=ids[cy[valid],cx[valid]];v=jj>=0
  rows.extend(ii[v]);cols.extend(jj[v]);weights.extend([np.hypot(dy,dx)]*sum(v))
 graph=csr_matrix((weights,(rows,cols)),shape=(len(yy),len(yy)));graph=graph+graph.T
 tree=minimum_spanning_tree(graph);tree=tree+tree.T
 if len(yy)==1:return np.array([[yy[0],xx[0],rad[yy[0],xx[0]]]])
 dd=dijkstra(tree,indices=0);start=np.argmax(np.where(np.isfinite(dd),dd,-1));dd,pred=dijkstra(tree,indices=start,return_predecessors=True);end=np.argmax(np.where(np.isfinite(dd),dd,-1))
 spine=set();node=end
 while node>=0:spine.add(node);node=pred[node]
 adj=[tree.indices[tree.indptr[i]:tree.indptr[i+1]].tolist() for i in range(len(yy))]
 path=[]
 def walk(v,parent):
  path.append(v)
  children=[u for u in adj[v] if u!=parent];children.sort(key=lambda u:u in spine)
  for u in children:
   walk(u,v)
   if not (v in spine and u in spine):path.append(v)
 import sys;sys.setrecursionlimit(200000)
 walk(start,-1)
 coords=np.c_[yy[path],xx[path],rad[yy[path],xx[path]]]
 # Subsample to 2 px along trajectory, always preserve meaningful corners/radius changes.
 chosen=[0];last=0
 for i in range(1,len(coords)-1):
